department: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra

investment_conditions.description: Applies to Micro, Small, Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and Large industrial units with minimum eligible fixed capital investment of ₹10 Lakhs.

eligibility_conditions: New manufacturing unit or existing unit undertaking minimum 25% expansion in fixed capital investment in Maharashtra
Must obtain Udyam Registration Certificate and Consent to Operate (CTO) from MPCB
Application must be submitted within 30 days of commencing commercial production
Unit must be situated in categorized industrial taluka zones (A, B, C, D, D+, or Vidarbha/Marathwada)
benefits: Industrial Promotion Subsidy (IPS): Refund of 60% to 100% of Gross State GST (SGST) paid on sales of finished goods for 7 to 14 years
Interest Subvention: 5% per annum on term loan interest for MSMEs (capped at ₹50 Lakhs/year)
Power Tariff Subsidy: ₹1.00 to ₹2.00 per unit reduction on industrial electricity tariff for 3 to 5 years in C, D, and D+ zones
Electricity Duty Exemption: 100% waiver on electricity duty for 7 to 10 years
Stamp Duty & Registration Fee Exemption: 100% waiver on land purchase, long-term lease deed, and loan hypothecation
required_documents: Udyam Registration Certificate / Industrial Entrepreneur Memorandum (IEM)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) certified by a Chartered Accountant
Consent to Establish (CTE) & Consent to Operate (CTO) from MPCB
Land Ownership Document (MIDC Allotment Letter / Registered Sale Deed / Registered Lease Deed)
Term Loan Sanction Letter and Bank Disbursement Certificate
Chartered Accountant Certificate of Eligible Fixed Capital Investment (Gross Plant & Machinery)
source: Government Resolution No. PSI-2019/CR-46/IND-8, Industries, Energy and Labour Department, Maharashtra

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
department: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) & Maharashtra State Food Processing Mission

investment_conditions.description: Aimed at micro food processing units with project outlay up to ₹3 Crore (eligible grant capped at ₹10 Lakhs per unit).

eligibility_conditions: Enterprise must be engaged in micro food processing / value-addition of agricultural or horticultural produce
Individual micro food enterprise ownership with minimum 10% promoter contribution
Priority given to One District One Product (ODOP) produce (e.g. Sugarcane/Jaggery in Pune, Onion in Nashik, Grapes in Sangli)
Must have or agree to obtain basic FSSAI registration/license
benefits: Credit-Linked Capital Subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with a ceiling of ₹10 Lakhs per enterprise
Seed Capital support of ₹40,000 per SHG member for working capital and small tool purchases
50% grant for Common Infrastructure, testing laboratories, and cold storage setup by FPOs/Cooperatives
50% subsidy for branding, marketing, and packaging standardization
required_documents: Identity and Address Proof of Applicant / Partners / Directors
Bank Account Statements for the last 6 months
FSSAI License / Registration or undertaking to obtain within 6 months
Quotations for food processing plant and machinery
Detailed Project Estimate / Quotations for civil works and equipment
Proof of premises ownership / Lease agreement
source: PMFME Scheme Guidelines, Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India (MoFPI)

department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME) / KVIC

investment_conditions.description: Project cost up to ₹50 Lakhs for manufacturing sector and up to ₹20 Lakhs for service sector.

eligibility_conditions: Any individual above 18 years of age (minimum 8th standard pass for manufacturing projects over ₹10 Lakhs)
Only for newly established micro projects; existing units not eligible for Phase 1 capital subsidy
Beneficiary contribution of 5% (Special Category: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Ex-servicemen/Differently-abled) or 10% (General Category)
No income ceiling for setting up projects under PMEGP
benefits: Margin Money (Capital Subsidy) of 25% of project cost for General Category in Rural areas (15% in Urban areas)
Margin Money (Capital Subsidy) of 35% of project cost for Special Categories (Women, SC/ST, Minorities) in Rural areas (25% in Urban areas)
Second Loan for Upgradation: Up to ₹1 Crore for existing successful PMEGP units with 15% (20% for special) subsidy
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Caste/Special Category Certificate (if applicable)
Educational Qualification Certificate (8th standard mark sheet / Degree)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) with cost of plant, machinery, raw material and working capital
Rural Area Certificate issued by Gram Panchayat / Tehsildar (for rural subsidy rate)
Bank Account details and in-principle consent letter
source: PMEGP Official Portal & Operational Guidelines, Ministry of MSME, Government of India

department: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra

investment_conditions.description: Manufacturing projects up to ₹50 Lakhs and Service/Agro-allied projects up to ₹20 Lakhs.

eligibility_conditions: Resident of Maharashtra between 18 to 45 years of age (up to 50 years for Special Category/SC/ST/Women)
Minimum 7th standard pass (10th standard pass for project cost above ₹25 Lakhs)
Promoter contribution of 5% (Special Category) or 10% (General Category)
benefits: Financial assistance (Financial Subsidy) of 15% to 35% of the total project cost based on urban/rural location and category
Bank loan facilitation through nationalized, private, and regional rural banks
Fast-track single-window clearance on the Maha-CMEGP portal
required_documents: Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Passport-size Photographs
School Leaving Certificate / Educational Marksheet
Detailed Project Profile with machinery and raw material quotations
Undertaking of not having availed subsidy under any other central/state self-employment scheme
source: Directorate of Industries, Maharashtra CMEGP Guidelines, GR No. CMEGP-2019/CR-145/IND-8
